title: Thursday Quick Tip
subtitle: Who cleans up
hook: Who picks up the balls and bases after your practice?
intro: Kids run to their parents. You collect every ball alone.
statement: Cleanup is a small way to build a team.
q1: Do you make cleanup part of every practice —
q2: or let kids go and do it yourself?
q3: What does it teach when everyone helps?
t1: Both can work. But kids take ownership
t2: when the team cares for its own gear.
ctaLines: Everyone grabs three balls. A cleanup race. I do it.
ctaPrompt: Share your habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
Who picks up the balls and bases after your practice?
Practice ends. Kids run to their parents. You collect every ball alone.
Cleanup is a small way to build a team.
A team job or a coach job. There is no perfect answer.
Who cleans up? Share your habit in the comments.
